# Mallorca Yacht Delivery

> Mallorca Yacht Delivery (mallorcayachtdelivery.com) is a yacht delivery service based in Palma de Mallorca, Spain. A professional skipper, with a deckhand or marine engineer when needed, moves motor yachts of 33–66 ft (10–20 m) by sea between ports in Mallorca and between Mallorca, Ibiza, Formentera and Menorca. Deliveries to or from mainland Spain are available on request.
>
> Mallorca Yacht Delivery es un servicio de transporte de barcos por mar con tripulación profesional y base en Palma de Mallorca.

Data updated 2026-10-26. Prices exclude Spanish VAT (21%).

## Pages
- [Home (Spanish)](https://www.mallorcayachtdelivery.com/): service overview, quote calculator, rates, routes, FAQ.
- [Home (English)](https://www.mallorcayachtdelivery.com/en/): the same in English.
- [Deliveries between Mallorca ports](https://www.mallorcayachtdelivery.com/traslado-barcos-entre-puertos-mallorca/): berth changes, boatyards, winter storage, sales handovers. Usually one day.
- [Ibiza & Formentera ↔ Mallorca](https://www.mallorcayachtdelivery.com/traslado-barco-ibiza-formentera-mallorca/)
- [Menorca ↔ Mallorca](https://www.mallorcayachtdelivery.com/traslado-barco-menorca-mallorca/)
- [Cargo ship loading in Palma (optional extra)](https://www.mallorcayachtdelivery.com/carga-yates-buque-caribe/)

## Rates
- Professional skipper 33–46 ft (10–14 m): €250–300 per day.
- Professional skipper 47–66 ft (15–20 m): €350–450 per day. Over 66 ft: on request.
- Deckhand: €160/day. Marine engineer on board: €250/day. Pre-departure engineer check: €280.
- Per diem: €40 per person per day from day two. Weather standby with crew in port: 60% of the day rate.
- Fuel, berths and port fees: paid by the owner at cost, with a €1,000–2,500 float settled against receipts.

## Examples (46 ft planing motor yacht, skipper only, excluding fuel)
- Port d'Alcúdia → Palma: 92 nm, 5 h 10 min at 18 kn, 1 day, ≈ €405 + VAT.
- Ibiza → Palma: 74 nm, 4 h 10 min at 18 kn, 2 days, ≈ €770 + VAT. Palma → Ibiza ≈ €430 + VAT.
- Ciutadella (Menorca) → Palma: 98 nm, 5 h 30 min at 18 kn, 2 days, ≈ €795 + VAT.

## Sea distances (nautical miles, approximate)
- Ibiza – Palma 74; Ibiza – Port d'Andratx 63; Formentera – Palma 82; Ibiza – Formentera 12.
- Ciutadella – Palma 98; Ciutadella – Port d'Alcúdia 37; Mahón (Maó) – Palma 113; Maó – Ciutadella 39.
- Palma – Port d'Alcúdia 92; Palma – Port de Sóller 51; Palma – Cala d'Or 48; Palma – Port d'Andratx 21.
- Mainland (on request): Barcelona – Palma 138; Valencia – Palma 148; Dénia – Palma 134.
